description: This Java class 'UploadChanges' provides a graphical user interface and logic for uploading configuration changes to a hardware device via a serial port connection. It initializes a UI window, manages serial port setup, reads configuration images from files, and schedules the upload process, including logging and exception handling.

classes.name: UploadChanges
classes.description: Main class providing UI setup, serial port communication, configuration image management, and upload scheduling.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application; initializes UI on the Event Dispatch Thread with a serial port argument.

methods.name: showUi
methods.description: Initializes serial port, reads configuration images, sets up the binary protocol, and starts upload process.

methods.name: scheduleUpload
methods.description: Schedules the upload of a new configuration image, optionally executing a callback after upload.

methods.name: createUiLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger that outputs to the UI and console, handling trace, info, and error messages.
